steps.label: Install
steps.code:
claude plugin marketplace add /path/to/fusion
claude plugin install fusion@fusion-first
ollama pull llama3.2:1b

steps.label: Test a prompt
steps.code:
fusion run start --prompt agent.txt --target ollama:llama3.2:1b --grader claude-cli
fusion run finalize --min-grade B

steps.label: Test an OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp)
Grade existing logs (no attacks)
steps.code: fusion run logs --file logs.jsonl --check everything --grader claude-cli

steps.label: Add intervals and a paired test to promptfoo results
Any Hugging Face GGUF, locally
steps.code:
ollama pull hf.co/bartowski/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
fusion run start --prompt agent.txt --target ollama:hf.co/bartowski/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M --grader claude-cli

steps.label: Hosted API with your key (metered: set FUSION_ALLOW_API_SPEND=1)
steps.code:
fusion run start --prompt agent.txt --target openai:gpt-4o-mini --grader claude-cli
fusion run start --prompt agent.txt --target hf:meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct --grader claude-cli

steps.label: Any workflow: a program that reads a JSON request on stdin
steps.code: fusion run start --prompt agent.txt --target "cmd:python fusion_adapter.py" --grader claude-cli

steps.label: In your pipeline
steps.code:
fusion run verify $RUN_ID --prompt agent.txt
fusion run finalize $RUN_ID --min-grade B

steps.label: In your agent's code
steps.code:
from fusion.guardrail.guard import Guardrail
from fusion.guardrail.policy import GuardConfig
from fusion.guardrail.client import GuardedModelClient

guard = Guardrail(GuardConfig(allowlisted_domains=["your-co.com"], secret_values=["sk-..."],
                              system_prompt=SYSTEM_PROMPT, require_authorization=True))
client = GuardedModelClient(your_model_client, guard)  # replies: secrets redacted, prompt dumps blocked

# before each tool call runs; user_message = the user's own words
outcome = guard.guard_tool_call(tool_name, tool_args, user_request=user_message, untrusted_context=True)
if outcome.blocked:
    ...  # don't run it
